identificationModule.briefTitle: Open-Label Extension of Other SZ1839 (Iressa) Trials
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multi-Centre, Open-Label Extension Trial of Treatment With ZD1839 (Iressa) in Patients Who Have Been Treated in Other ZD1839 Clinical Trials and May Benefit From Continued Monotherapy ZD 1839.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A trial to assess patients who have been treated with Iressa in a previous clinical trial and may benefit from continued treatment with Iressa.

keywords: Patients diagnosed with cancer who have previously received Iressa in an Iressa clinical trial

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Received treatment in a previous Iressa clinical trial
* Provided Informed Consent to participate in the trial
* 30 days or less since completing the previous Iressa trial.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Radiotherapy completed more than 14 days before starting treatment in this trial
* Incomplete healing from prior surgery
* Withdrawal from previous Iressa trial due to unacceptable toxicity to major organs
